serverUrl.title: Provenza server
serverUrl.description: The address of your Provenza installation, e.g. https://provenza.example.com

ingestionKey.title: Ingestion key
ingestionKey.description: A browser-extension ingestion key (Settings > Ingestion Sources in Provenza).

userEmail.title: User's e-mail
userEmail.description: Who uses this browser, as your organization knows them. Set per user (e.g. a user-level policy written at sign-in); Provenza shows it on the AI services they visit.
